sources.descriptor: How many public Bluesky posts named the service with an outage word: what members of the public said, unverified, never what the company said.
sources.licence: No data licence stated; Blackout keeps and republishes only post counts and a link to Bluesky's own search, never a post, its text or its author (Bluesky's developer guidelines ask apps to honour deletions)
sources.title: Posts naming the service with "down" or "outage": counts only

properties.summary: Members of the public posted 66 times on Bluesky naming "911" with "down" (66) or "outage" (0) in the 6 hours to 21:45 UTC 26 Nov 2026, against a usual of 2.9 for that many hours over the 7 days before. Posts were already over the line in the window's first hour (from 15:45 UTC 26 Nov 2026) and peaked in the hour from 17:45 UTC 26 Nov 2026. Reported by the public on Bluesky and not confirmed by 911 emergency calls; Blackout counts the posts and does not read or keep them. Blackout does not assess its cause. A surge can also be news of an outage elsewhere that names the company, a joke, the words in another sense, or the company's own denial (BO-H-7B).
properties.title: 911 emergency calls: 66 public Bluesky posts report it down or out in 6 h (usual 2.9)
